column1: # Tier 1 — Deterministic eval set (~25 questions)
# Columns: question<TAB>reference_sql<TAB>expected_value
# - expected_value for a scalar answer: the literal value as a string.
# - expected_value for a list answer: "|"-joined values; scorer parses
#   and computes Jaccard ≥ 0.8.
# - reference_sql is the query that produced expected_value at the
#   frozen delta version {env}.gold_*. Re-run it after a gold refresh to
#   regenerate ground truth; do NOT leave stale expected_values.
# - When expected_value is unresolved for this env, leave it as
#   "TBD:<short-name>" and the loader marks the question as pending so
#   it contributes to coverage but not to the pass rate.
# Keep this file ASCII + one question per line; the loader splits on
# raw tabs and does not support CSV quoting for Tier 1.
question
column2: reference_sql

column1: How many recall campaigns were issued for Tesla in 2023?
column2: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_number) FROM {schema}.gold_recalls_fact WHERE make_norm = 'Tesla' AND YEAR(report_received_date) = 2023

column1: How many recall campaigns were issued for Ford in 2024?
column2: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_number) FROM {schema}.gold_recalls_fact WHERE make_norm = 'Ford' AND YEAR(report_received_date) = 2024

column1: How many consumer complaints mention 'airbag' for Honda Civic model year 2022?
column2: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {schema}.gold_complaints_fact WHERE make_norm = 'Honda' AND model = 'Civic' AND model_year = 2022 AND LOWER(complaint_text) LIKE '%airbag%'

column1: How many vehicles were potentially affected by Takata airbag recalls?
column2: SELECT SUM(potentially_affected) FROM {schema}.gold_recalls_fact WHERE LOWER(component) LIKE '%air bag%' AND LOWER(summary) LIKE '%takata%'

column1: Top 3 OEM groups by complaint volume in 2024 (ordered).
column2: SELECT oem_group FROM {schema}.gold_complaints_fact WHERE YEAR(date_received) = 2024 GROUP BY oem_group ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

column1: List all OEM groups with open engineering analyses on EV batteries as of 2025-12-31.
column2: SELECT DISTINCT oem_group FROM {schema}.gold_investig_fact WHERE investigation_type = 'EA' AND status = 'open' AND LOWER(component) LIKE '%battery%' AND open_date <= '2025-12-31'

column1: Which Tesla model had the most complaints in 2024?
column2: SELECT model FROM {schema}.gold_complaints_fact WHERE make_norm = 'Tesla' AND YEAR(date_received) = 2024 GROUP BY model ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

column1: How many TSBs were issued by General Motors in 2023?
column2: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {schema}.gold_tsbs_fact WHERE oem_group = 'General Motors' AND YEAR(tsb_date) = 2023

column1: How many SGO AV-related crashes were reported in California in 2024?
column2: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {schema}.gold_sgo_fact WHERE state = 'CA' AND YEAR(incident_date) = 2024

column1: How many Ford F-150 recalls mention 'brake' in the summary since 2020?
column2: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_number) FROM {schema}.gold_recalls_fact WHERE make_norm = 'Ford' AND model = 'F-150' AND report_received_date >= '2020-01-01' AND LOWER(summary) LIKE '%brake%'

column1: Top 5 component groups by recall volume in 2024 (ordered).
column2: SELECT component_group FROM {schema}.gold_recalls_fact WHERE YEAR(report_received_date) = 2024 GROUP BY component_group ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

column1: What year had the highest volume of Toyota recalls in the last decade?
column2: SELECT YEAR(report_received_date) FROM {schema}.gold_recalls_fact WHERE make_norm = 'Toyota' AND report_received_date >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(report_received_date) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

column1: How many investigations were opened on Hyundai/Kia engines since 2022?
column2: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {schema}.gold_investig_fact WHERE oem_group = 'Hyundai Motor Group' AND LOWER(component) LIKE '%engine%' AND open_date >= '2022-01-01'

column1: Total vehicles affected by Stellantis recalls in 2024.
column2: SELECT SUM(potentially_affected) FROM {schema}.gold_recalls_fact WHERE oem_group = 'Stellantis' AND YEAR(report_received_date) = 2024

column1: How many Rivian recalls have been issued to date?
column2: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_number) FROM {schema}.gold_recalls_fact WHERE make_norm = 'Rivian'

column1: How many complaints reference 'phantom braking' for Tesla Model 3 in 2023-2024?
column2: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {schema}.gold_complaints_fact WHERE make_norm = 'Tesla' AND model = 'Model 3' AND YEAR(date_received) BETWEEN 2023 AND 2024 AND LOWER(complaint_text) LIKE '%phantom braking%'

column1: List the top 3 makes by number of open preliminary evaluations as of 2026-01-01.
column2: SELECT make_norm FROM {schema}.gold_investig_fact WHERE investigation_type = 'PE' AND status = 'open' AND open_date <= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY make_norm ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

column1: How many TSBs reference 'infotainment' across all OEMs in 2024?
column2: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {schema}.gold_tsbs_fact WHERE YEAR(tsb_date) = 2024 AND LOWER(summary) LIKE '%infotainment%'

column1: How many recall campaigns had fewer than 100 vehicles affected in 2024?
column2: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {schema}.gold_recalls_fact WHERE YEAR(report_received_date) = 2024 AND potentially_affected < 100

column1: Which investigation types appear most frequently over the last 5 years, ordered?
column2: SELECT investigation_type FROM {schema}.gold_investig_fact WHERE open_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1825) GROUP BY investigation_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

column1: How many recalls relate to EV battery thermal events since 2022?
column2: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_number) FROM {schema}.gold_recalls_fact WHERE report_received_date >= '2022-01-01' AND LOWER(summary) LIKE '%battery%' AND (LOWER(summary) LIKE '%thermal%' OR LOWER(summary) LIKE '%fire%')

column1: How many complaints cite 'unintended acceleration' in 2023?
column2: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {schema}.gold_complaints_fact WHERE YEAR(date_received) = 2023 AND LOWER(complaint_text) LIKE '%unintended acceleration%'

column1: Which 3 model years have the most open recalls still active today?
column2: SELECT model_year FROM {schema}.gold_recalls_fact WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY model_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

column1: How many investigations closed in 2024 resulted in a recall?
column2: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {schema}.gold_investig_fact WHERE YEAR(close_date) = 2024 AND outcome = 'recall'

column1: What fraction of 2024 complaints involve ADAS features? (decimal)
column2: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(complaint_text) LIKE '%adas%' OR LOWER(complaint_text) LIKE '%autopilot%' OR LOWER(complaint_text) LIKE '%lane keep%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 3) FROM {schema}.gold_complaints_fact WHERE YEAR(date_received) = 2024
